Justice Department sent target letters in Alaska Senate criminal probe. Here’s what that means, The Associated Press reports.
Americans are casting their votes Tuesday in U.S. midterm elections that will serve as a referendum on President Donald Trump’s chaotic and controversial second term, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
